issue_context.title: TileSet not detecting almost zero alpha tiles
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

v4.0.alpha1.official [31a7ddbf8]

### System information

Windows 10

### Issue description

![Light](https://i.postimg.cc/4NfXvVPS/Light.gif)

Here is a set of 32 'light' tiles that are black with changing alpha...
When the TileSet automatically detects tiles or I manually trigger a detection with the menu item it ignores 4 tiles with non-zero alpha. The menu item says "Create Tiles in Non-Transparent Texture Regions" so I expect it to ignore the last one because it has alpha 0 but the rest do not.

Thanks.


### Steps to reproduce

1. Open TileSet and "Create Tiles in Non-Transparent Texture Regions"

### Minimal reproduction project

https://github.com/rakkarage/TestLight
comments:
0.1 seems high for default? Everything under 10% alpha is discarded?
I tested with 0.01 and my example works fine.
Edit: I am thinking I am fixing it in the gif by selecting those last few tiles... but it is already too late and the engine has not copied them? I am selecting nothing? :(

> but it is already too late

You can just manually create those tiles

Thanks. Sorry, I was assuming it happening in other places too like tile merge, etc but they all come through merge fine. It is just a dialog not actually editing data/image. 0.1 still does seem high... like me.

review_comments: This is not great, it means whoever calls the function first will generate it (and cache it) with a different mask. I also think the current threshold should be good enough for most cases (not entirely transparent basically), so I am not sure why it should be changed)
It needs to be changed for the issue I linked. For that reason it had to be configurable first, hence all the changes. Is there a better way to fix the issue?
